import zipfile,sys
from lxml import etree
W="{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
z=zipfile.ZipFile("documents/sellers-redline-markup.docx")
root=etree.fromstring(z.read("word/document.xml"))
body=root.find(W+"body")
out=[]
authors=set()
for i,p in enumerate(body.iter(W+"p")):
    s="";ch=False
    for el in p.iter():
        if el.tag==W+"t" or el.tag==W+"delText":
            anc=[a.tag for a in el.iterancestors()]
            txt=el.text or ""
            if W+"del" in anc: s+="[[DEL:"+txt+"]]";ch=True
            elif W+"ins" in anc: s+="[[INS:"+txt+"]]";ch=True
            else: s+=txt
        if el.tag in (W+"ins",W+"del"): authors.add((el.get(W+"author"),el.get(W+"date")))
    ppr=p.find(W+"pPr")
    if ppr is not None and ppr.find(W+"rPr") is not None:
        r=ppr.find(W+"rPr")
        if r.find(W+"ins") is not None: s="{PARA-INS}"+s;ch=True
        if r.find(W+"del") is not None: s="{PARA-DEL}"+s;ch=True
    s=s.replace("]][[DEL:","").replace("]][[INS:","") if False else s
    out.append((i,ch,s))
mode=sys.argv[1]
for i,ch,s in out:
    if mode=="all" or ch: print(f"P{i}{\" *\" if ch else \"\"}: {s}\n")
print(authors)

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)
st = doc.styles['Normal']
st.font.name = 'Times New Roman'; st.font.size = Pt(11)
st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), 'Times New Roman')
st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
for h,sz in [('Heading 1',13),('Heading 2',12),('Heading 3',11)]:
    s = doc.styles[h]; s.font.name='Times New Roman'; s.font.size=Pt(sz); s.font.bold=True
    s.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F,0x2A,0x44)
    s.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'),'Times New Roman')
    s.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12); s.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)

def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd'); shd.set(qn('w:val'),'clear'); shd.set(qn('w:color'),'auto'); shd.set(qn('w:fill'),color)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def rich(p, text, size=None):
    # **bold** markup
    parts = text.split('**')
    for i,pt in enumerate(parts):
        if not pt: continue
        r = p.add_run(pt); r.bold = (i%2==1)
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def para(text, bold=False, italic=False, align=None, size=None, after=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    if bold or italic:
        r = p.add_run(text); r.bold=bold; r.italic=italic
        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)
    else:
        rich(p, text, size)
    if align=='c': p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if align=='j': p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    return p

def bullet(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet' if level==0 else 'List Bullet 2')
    rich(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def num(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Number'); rich(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(3); return p

def table(headers, rows, widths, size=8.5, header_fill='1F2A44', fills=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = 'Table Grid'; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text=''
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(size); r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, header_fill)
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); th = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); th.set(qn('w:val'),'true'); trPr.append(th)
    for ri,row in enumerate(rows):
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i,val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text=''
            lines = val.split('\n')
            for li,ln in enumerate(lines):
                p = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if li==0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(1)
                rich(p, ln, size)
            if fills and fills[ri] and i==0: shade(cells[i], fills[ri])
    for row in t.rows:
        for i,w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)
    return t
EOF
